# Anthroly

> Anthroly is a data lab. It buys, licenses and brokers operational data from US companies (team chat, email, support tickets, CRM history, call recordings, code review, documents, ERP exports and field records) and supplies it to frontier AI labs as de-identified training corpora, RL environments, agent trajectories, preference/SFT data and held-out evaluation sets. Anthroly sources only from companies headquartered in the United States and sells to every major AI lab. It has bought, sold and brokered more than $900K in data.
> Contact: sharatth@anthroly.com · https://www.anthroly.com/contact

## Key facts

- Role: principal buyer (licenses data directly and supplies labs) and broker (arranges direct licenses between US companies and labs).
- Sourcing: US companies only. No exceptions.
- Structure: bounded licenses, not outright sales. Sellers keep ownership and keep using their data.
- Safeguards: identifiers removed before anything moves; consistent placeholders preserve structure; licenses prohibit re-identification; sellers are never named to buyers.
- Pricing: every record priced individually after a de-identified sample review. No fee charged to sellers.
